blurb: Clifton Highlands Golf Club offers 27 holes including an 18 Hole Par 72 Champions Course and a 9 Hole Par 3 Plateau Course. The club provides golf lessons, group clinics, and junior golf programs. Practice facilities include two putting greens, a sand bunker, and a driving range with real grass tee stations.
extraNote: Group clinics require sign up at the Pro Shop in person or by calling 715-262-5141 · Men’s golf leagues form in March and April annually
